newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bundesbank to issue gold statement - govt sources.
newsitem.headline: Bundesbank to issue gold statement - govt sources.

text.p: Germany's Bundesbank is expected on Wednesday to issue a statement outlining its position on a planned revaluation of its gold reserves, German government coalition sources said on Tuesday.

The sources added that the central bank council had basically accepted the plan for a higher valuation of its gold reserves and would be unlikely to seek to prevent it taking effect in 1997, with a resulting boost to Bundesbank profits.
Neither Finance Minister Theo Waigel nor his State Secretary Juergen Stark will be present at the regular council meeting preceding the expected statement, the sources said.
The finance ministry had already informed the Bundesbank of the key changes to its consitution required for the revaluation to go ahead, they added.
